author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Researchers at EPFL developed a robotic hand with six symmetrical, silicone-tipped fingers that can detach and crawl like a spider to manipulate objects in tight spaces. It surpasses human hand capabilities and can carry loads up to 2 kilograms. 

Source Article: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-025-67675-8
